item.title: Small Living Room Layout: Keep a 30–36-Inch Walkway
item.description: A small living room usually fails in one quiet way: the furniture fits, but you cannot walk through the room without turning sideways. The sofa looks right in the photo of the listing, the coffee table sits where it always sat, and then a laundry basket or a guest with a bag has nowhere to go. This guide flips the usual order. Instead of picking furniture and hoping a path appears, you reserve the walking route first and fit the furniture into what is left.
